blocks.zh: 實施架構 S4-S5：商業案例與開發
blocks.en: Implementation Framework S4-S5: Business Case and Development

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives for This Section

blocks.zh: 理解 Implementation S4（商業案例）階段的目標與主要產出文件 — Project Execution Plan (PEP)
blocks.en: Understand the objectives and key deliverable of the Implementation S4 (Business Case) stage: the Project Execution Plan (PEP)

blocks.zh: 掌握設施層級、設備層級與營運層級整合計畫的規劃方法
blocks.en: Master how to plan the facility-level, equipment-level and operational-level integration plans

blocks.zh: 學習供應商選擇與供應鏈審查的風險管理方法
blocks.en: Learn the risk-management approach to supplier selection and supply-chain review

blocks.zh: 了解 Implementation S5（開發）階段的使用者需求、佈局設計、規格與標準化策略
blocks.en: Understand the user requirements, layout and design, specification and standardization strategy of Implementation S5 (Development)

blocks.zh: 認識 Extractables & Leachables (E&L) 資料庫建立與採購流程的關鍵考量
blocks.en: Recognize the key considerations for building an Extractables & Leachables (E&L) database and for the procurement process

blocks.zh: 7.4 Implementation S4: Business Case 7.4 實施階段 S4：商業案例
blocks.en: 7.4 Implementation S4: Business Case

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Implementation S4: Business Case（商業案例階段）— 在完成 S3 的範圍界定之後，S4 階段聚焦於將 SUS 策略轉化為具體的商業與技術方案。此階段的核心產出是 Project Execution Plan (PEP，專案執行計畫)，它是整個實施專案的主要路線圖文件。
blocks.en: Implementation S4: Business Case - After the scope has been defined in S3, S4 focuses on turning the SUS strategy into a concrete business and technical solution. The core output of this stage is the Project Execution Plan (PEP), the main roadmap document for the whole implementation project.

blocks.zh: Business Drivers（商業驅動因素）— 影響 SUS 實施方向的關鍵商業因素，包括產品類型（藥物活性成分 vs 藥品）、產品生命週期階段（臨床前 vs GMP 生產）、產品性質（生物製劑 vs 化學實體）以及圍阻需求。
blocks.en: Business Drivers - The key business factors that shape the direction of SUS implementation, including product type (active pharmaceutical ingredient vs. drug product), product life-cycle stage (preclinical vs. GMP manufacturing), product nature (biologic vs. chemical entity) and containment needs.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: S4 階段就像建造新工廠之前的「商業企劃書」。想像你要開一家餐廳 — 在裝潢施工之前，你必須先決定：賣什麼菜（產品類型）、目標客群是誰（臨床階段 vs 商業生產）、是西餐還是中餐（生物製劑 vs 化學實體）、以及是否需要特殊通風設備（圍阻需求）。PEP 就是這份完整的開店企劃書。
blocks.en: The S4 stage is like the business plan you write before building a new plant. Imagine opening a restaurant: before any fit-out begins, you must decide what to serve (product type), who the target customers are (clinical stage vs. commercial production), whether it is Western or Chinese cuisine (biologic vs. chemical entity), and whether you need special ventilation equipment (containment needs). The PEP is that complete business plan for opening the restaurant.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: PEP 是 S4 的核心產出。它不僅定義預算、時程和品質目標，還整合了設施、製程和供應鏈等所有面向。一個結構不完整的 PEP 會直接導致後續實施階段的混亂與延誤。對 CDMO 而言，每個客戶專案都應有對應的 PEP 來確保 SUS 實施的系統性。
blocks.en: The PEP is the core output of S4. It defines not only the budget, schedule and quality objectives, but also integrates every aspect, including facility, process and supply chain. A PEP with an incomplete structure will directly cause confusion and delays in later implementation stages. For a CDMO, each client project should have its own PEP to ensure SUS implementation is systematic.

blocks.zh: 7.4.1 Project Execution Plan 7.4.1 專案執行計畫
blocks.en: 7.4.1 Project Execution Plan

blocks.zh: PEP (Project Execution Plan，專案執行計畫)— 這是 SUS 實施的「總綱文件」。它涵蓋 12 大主題，從專案簡介、範圍界定、合約文件、品質策略、風險管理，一路延伸到 HSE（健康安全環境）、採購安裝、教育訓練和移交支援。
blocks.en: PEP (Project Execution Plan) - This is the "master document" for SUS implementation. It covers 12 main topics, from project introduction, scope definition, contract documents, quality strategy and risk management through to HSE (health, safety and environment), procurement and installation, training, and handover and support.

blocks.zh: VMP (Validation Master Plan，確效主計畫)— 與 PEP 並行的確效規劃文件，定義整個 SUS 的確效策略、範圍和時程。
blocks.en: VMP (Validation Master Plan) - The validation planning document that runs in parallel with the PEP and defines the validation strategy, scope and schedule for the entire SUS.

blocks.zh: Table 7.4.1-1🔍 的 12 個章節結構提供了 PEP 的完整藍圖。注意幾個容易被忽略的重點：
blocks.en: The 12-chapter structure in Table 7.4.1-1🔍 provides a complete blueprint for the PEP. Note a few points that are easily overlooked:

blocks.zh: 第 6 章 Organization：包含衝突解決機制 — 這對多部門協作的 SUS 專案至關重要
blocks.en: Chapter 6, Organization: includes a conflict-resolution mechanism, which is essential for SUS projects involving many departments

blocks.zh: 第 8 章 Risk Management：不只是風險評估，還要有具體的緩解策略和計畫
blocks.en: Chapter 8, Risk Management: this is not only risk assessment; it also needs concrete mitigation strategies and plans

blocks.zh: 第 11 章 Handover：包含 Materials Management（物料管理），這是 SUS 持續運作的關鍵
blocks.en: Chapter 11, Handover: includes Materials Management, which is key to keeping the SUS operating over time

blocks.zh: PEP 的內容深度應依據專案複雜度調整 — 小型 SUS 專案可以精簡，大型設施建置專案則需要完整展開。
blocks.en: The depth of PEP content should be adjusted to project complexity: a small SUS project can use a lean PEP, while a large facility build requires a fully developed one.

blocks.zh: PEP 的 12 個章節就像蓋房子時的「建築設計說明書」。第 1-4 章是「我們要蓋什麼」；第 5-6 章是「誰來蓋、怎麼蓋」；第 7-8 章是「品質和風險怎麼管」；第 9 章是「安全和環保」；第 10-11 章是「實際施工到驗收移交」；第 12 章是「附件和參考資料」。少了任何一個部分，房子都可能出問題。
blocks.en: The 12 chapters of the PEP are like the "architectural design specification" for building a house. Chapters 1-4 are "what we are going to build"; chapters 5-6 are "who builds it and how"; chapters 7-8 are "how quality and risk are managed"; chapter 9 is "safety and environment"; chapters 10-11 are "actual construction through to acceptance and handover"; and chapter 12 is "appendices and references". If any part is missing, the house can go wrong.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 如果你的 CDMO 同時為三個不同客戶的生物藥品建置 SUS 產線，PEP 中的哪些章節最需要客製化？
blocks.en: If your CDMO is building SUS production lines for biologic drug products for three different clients at the same time, which chapters of the PEP most need to be customized?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 PEP 需要包含「衝突解決」(Conflict Resolution) 機制？請舉一個 SUS 實施中可能發生的跨部門衝突情境。
blocks.en: Why does the PEP need to include a Conflict Resolution mechanism? Give an example of a cross-department conflict that could occur during SUS implementation.

blocks.zh: 7.4.2 Process and Facility Requirements: Basis of Approach 7.4.2 製程與廠房需求：方法基礎
blocks.en: 7.4.2 Process and Facility Requirements: Basis of Approach

blocks.zh: SUS 整合需要從三個不同的視角來規劃，產出三份文件：
blocks.en: SUS integration needs to be planned from three different perspectives, producing three documents:

blocks.zh: Facility-Level Plan（設施層級計畫）— SUS 如何融入設施設計空間
blocks.en: Facility-Level Plan - how the SUS fits into the facility design space

blocks.zh: Implementation-Level Plan（實施層級計畫）— 供應商和終端使用者在生產、行銷和供應 SUS 時的參數
blocks.en: Implementation-Level Plan - the parameters for suppliers and end users in producing, marketing and supplying SUS

blocks.zh: Operational-Level Plan（營運層級計畫）— SUS 組裝、連接和部署的參數
blocks.en: Operational-Level Plan - the parameters for assembling, connecting and deploying the SUS

blocks.zh: 當 SUS 整合程度很高時，可能需要全新的設施設計。這是因為 SU 和 MU 系統在結構上有根本差異：SU 不需要 CIP/SIP 管路、不需要大量公用設施連接，但需要更多的倉儲空間、廢棄物處理區域和人員操作動線。這個決策點對 CDMO 的資本支出影響巨大。
blocks.en: When the degree of SUS integration is high, a completely new facility design may be needed. This is because SU and MU systems differ fundamentally in structure: an SU system needs no CIP/SIP piping and no extensive utility connections, but it needs more storage space, waste-handling areas and personnel operating flow. This decision point has a major impact on a CDMO's capital expenditure.

blocks.zh: 7.4.3-7.4.5 Three-Level Integration Plans 7.4.3-7.4.5 三層次整合計畫
blocks.en: 7.4.3-7.4.5 Three-Level Integration Plans

blocks.zh: 三個層級的整合計畫形成一個從宏觀到微觀的規劃架構：
blocks.en: The three levels of integration plans form a planning framework running from the macro to the micro:

blocks.zh: Facility-Level（設施層級）— 回答「SUS 在廠房中的位置在哪裡？」
blocks.en: Facility-Level - answers "Where does the SUS sit in the plant?"

blocks.zh: Implementation-Level（實施層級）— 回答「SUS 設備從哪裡來？是外購還是自製？」
blocks.en: Implementation-Level - answers "Where does the SUS equipment come from? Is it bought in or made in-house?"

blocks.zh: Operational-Level（營運層級）— 回答「SUS 怎麼組裝、連接、部署到可以開始生產？」
blocks.en: Operational-Level - answers "How is the SUS assembled, connected and deployed until it is ready to start production?"

blocks.zh: 三個層級計畫就像規劃一場大型宴會：Facility-Level 是選擇場地和空間配置（宴會廳的桌椅怎麼擺放）；Implementation-Level 是決定食材和餐具的來源（自己煮還是外燴？餐具買現成的還是訂製？）；Operational-Level 是當天的準備流程（菜色如何上桌、餐具如何擺設、服務人員如何走動）。
blocks.en: The three levels of plans are like planning a large banquet: Facility-Level is choosing the venue and space layout (how the tables and chairs in the banquet hall are arranged); Implementation-Level is deciding where the food and tableware come from (cook it yourself or hire a caterer? buy standard tableware or order custom?); Operational-Level is the preparation workflow on the day (how dishes are served, how tableware is set, how the service staff move around).

blocks.zh: Implementation-Level Plan 中提到兩種 SUS 來源：off-the-shelf（現成品）和 self-made（自製品）。這個選擇對風險管理有重大影響 — 自製 SUS 雖然靈活度高，但需要自行承擔規格制定、批次紀錄、適格性確認和穩定性研究等所有品質責任。
blocks.en: The Implementation-Level Plan mentions two sources of SUS: off-the-shelf and self-made. This choice has a major impact on risk management: self-made SUS offers high flexibility, but you must take on all the quality responsibilities yourself, including specification setting, batch records, qualification and stability studies.

blocks.zh: 7.4.6 Facility-Level Integration Plan 7.4.6 廠房層次整合計畫
blocks.en: 7.4.6 Facility-Level Integration Plan

blocks.zh: Facility Design Space（設施設計空間）— 指設施中可供 SUS 整合的物理和功能空間。這不僅是地板面積的問題，還包括潔淨度等級、公用設施配置、人員動線和物流動線的整體規劃。
blocks.en: Facility Design Space - the physical and functional space in the facility available for SUS integration. This is not only a matter of floor area; it also involves the overall planning of cleanliness classification, utility layout, personnel flow and material flow.

blocks.zh: RAT (Regulatory Assessment Table，法規評估表)— 一種實用工具，用於將法規要求與使用者的具體應對策略進行交叉對照。例如，針對 ICH Q7A 的某一條款，RAT 會記錄該條款的原文以及使用者計畫如何滿足該要求。
blocks.en: RAT (Regulatory Assessment Table) - a practical tool for cross-referencing regulatory requirements against the user's specific response. For example, for a given clause of ICH Q7A, the RAT records the original text of the clause together with how the user plans to meet that requirement.

blocks.zh: GEP (Good Engineering Practice，良好工程實務)— 為工程專案提供系統性框架的方法論，涵蓋專案工程、共通實務、營運和維護等面向。
blocks.en: GEP (Good Engineering Practice) - a methodology that provides a systematic framework for engineering projects, covering project engineering, common practices, operations and maintenance.

blocks.zh: 設施層級整合的 12 個參數清單非常重要，特別注意以下幾點：
blocks.en: The list of 12 facility-level integration parameters is very important. Pay particular attention to the following:

blocks.zh: Cross-contamination avoidance（避免交叉污染）— SUS 本身就是降低交叉污染風險的有效手段，但設施設計仍需考慮人員流動和物料流動的隔離
blocks.en: Cross-contamination avoidance - SUS is itself an effective means of reducing cross-contamination risk, but facility design must still consider segregation of personnel flow and material flow

blocks.zh: Process validation — 從 MUS 轉換到 SUS 時，即使製程相同，因設備型態改變（如體積比、攪拌方式）可能需要重新進行製程確效
blocks.en: Process validation - when moving from MUS to SUS, even if the process is the same, the change in equipment type (such as volume ratio and mixing method) may require process validation to be repeated

blocks.zh: Dependence on utilities — SUS 設施通常較不依賴 WFI、純蒸汽等公用設施，但對倉儲和廢棄物處理的需求增加
blocks.en: Dependence on utilities - SUS facilities are generally less dependent on utilities such as WFI and pure steam, but need more storage and waste handling

blocks.zh: 設施層級整合就像在既有的社區中規劃一棟新建築。你不能只看建築本身的設計（SUS 設備），還必須考慮周圍的道路（物流動線）、供水電力（公用設施）、停車位（倉儲空間）、消防通道（安全規範）、鄰居的影響（交叉污染風險）以及市政法規（GMP 要求）。RAT 就是你用來逐條檢查建築法規是否符合的核對表。
blocks.en: Facility-level integration is like planning a new building in an existing neighborhood. You cannot look only at the design of the building itself (the SUS equipment); you must also consider the surrounding roads (material flow), water and power supply (utilities), parking (storage space), fire access (safety regulations), the impact on neighbors (cross-contamination risk) and municipal regulations (GMP requirements). The RAT is the checklist you use to verify, clause by clause, that the building complies with the code.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 強調設施整合需要「holistic approach」（整體性方法）？如果只關注單一因素（如設備尺寸），可能會遺漏哪些風險？
blocks.en: Why does TR66 stress that facility integration requires a "holistic approach"? If you focus on only a single factor (such as equipment size), what risks might be missed?

blocks.zh: 請解釋 RAT 如何幫助 CDMO 在面對法規查核時快速展示合規策略。
blocks.en: Explain how a RAT helps a CDMO quickly demonstrate its compliance strategy during a regulatory inspection.

blocks.zh: 7.4.6 Regulatory Assessment Table (RAT) Example 7.4.6 法規評估表（RAT）範例
blocks.en: 7.4.6 Regulatory Assessment Table (RAT) Example

blocks.zh: RAT（法規評估表）的實際運作方式：
blocks.en: How the RAT (Regulatory Assessment Table) works in practice:

blocks.zh: 左欄：列出法規原文的相關條款編號和內容
blocks.en: Left column: lists the relevant clause numbers and text of the regulation

blocks.zh: 右欄：記錄使用者（公司）針對每一條款的具體因應政策
blocks.en: Right column: records the user's (company's) specific policy for each clause

blocks.zh: 這種「法規原文 vs 公司政策」的對照格式，讓查核員和內部團隊都能清楚看到每一項法規要求是如何被滿足的。
blocks.en: This "regulatory text vs. company policy" format lets both inspectors and internal teams see clearly how each regulatory requirement is met.

blocks.zh: 注意 Table 7.4.6-1🔍 中幾個重要的政策聲明：
blocks.en: Note several important policy statements in Table 7.4.6-1🔍:

blocks.zh: 18.30 對應政策：所有無菌添加都在封閉系統中進行 — 這正是 SUS 的核心優勢
blocks.en: Policy for 18.30: all sterile additions are made in closed systems, which is a core advantage of SUS

blocks.zh: 18.31 對應政策：開放式連接必須在 EU-GMP Grade A + 背景 Grade B 環境下進行 — 這是典型的 SUS-MUS 混合操作的風險控制
blocks.en: Policy for 18.31: open connections must be made in an EU-GMP Grade A environment with a Grade B background, a typical risk control for mixed SUS-MUS operations

blocks.zh: 18.34 對應政策：上游製程設備使用 SUS，只使用一次 — 直接消除清潔確效的需求
blocks.en: Policy for 18.34: upstream process equipment uses SUS, used only once, which directly eliminates the need for cleaning validation

blocks.zh: 18.38 對應政策：混合系統中的 MUS 部件（如鋼製取樣閥）需要經過確效的 CIP 程序
blocks.en: Policy for 18.38: MUS parts in a hybrid system (such as steel sampling valves) require a validated CIP procedure

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 建議 CDMO 為每個新的 SUS 實施專案建立自己的 RAT。除了 ICH Q7A 之外，也可以針對以下法規建立 RAT：
blocks.en: CDMOs are advised to build their own RAT for every new SUS implementation project. In addition to ICH Q7A, RATs can also be built for the following regulations:

blocks.zh: EU GMP Annex 1（無菌藥品製造）
blocks.en: EU GMP Annex 1 (Manufacture of Sterile Medicinal Products)

blocks.zh: ICH Q8-Q12（品質設計與生命週期管理）
blocks.en: ICH Q8-Q12 (quality by design and lifecycle management)

blocks.zh: RAT 可以作為法規查核的「預防性準備工具」，也是跨部門溝通法規要求的統一語言。
blocks.en: A RAT can serve as a "preventive preparation tool" for regulatory inspections, and also as a common language for communicating regulatory requirements across departments.

blocks.zh: 7.4.7 Equipment-Level Integration Plan 7.4.7 設備層次整合計畫
blocks.en: 7.4.7 Equipment-Level Integration Plan

blocks.zh: Equipment-Level Integration Plan（設備層級整合計畫）涵蓋 18 個驗證參數，這些參數可以分為幾大類：
blocks.en: The Equipment-Level Integration Plan covers 18 validation parameters, which can be grouped into several broad categories:

blocks.zh: 物理與機械：工作體積、壓力、溫度範圍、攪拌混合、物理支撐
blocks.en: Physical and mechanical: working volume, pressure, temperature range, agitation and mixing, physical support

blocks.zh: 化學相容性：有機溶劑、氣體滲透性、化學消毒循環
blocks.en: Chemical compatibility: organic solvents, gas permeability, chemical sanitization cycles

blocks.zh: 生物學影響：細胞生長動力學、生物圍阻能力
blocks.en: Biological impact: cell growth kinetics, biocontainment capability

blocks.zh: 物流與後勤：運輸條件、搬運保護
blocks.en: Logistics: transport conditions, handling protection

blocks.zh: 系統整合：控制系統確效、不斷電系統 (UPS)、標準化
blocks.en: System integration: control system validation, uninterruptible power supply (UPS), standardization

blocks.zh: S4 階段有兩個關鍵假設：(1) 已有足夠的製程知識，(2) 設計審查基於風險方法。這意味著如果製程知識不足就貿然進入 S4，可能導致設備規格不正確，後續的修改代價極高。
blocks.en: The S4 stage rests on two key assumptions: (1) sufficient process knowledge is already available, and (2) design review is based on a risk-based approach. This means that entering S4 without adequate process knowledge can lead to incorrect equipment specifications, and later changes are extremely costly.

blocks.zh: 另一個重要觀點：與大型 SUS 供應商建立夥伴關係可以降低風險，因為他們有豐富的應用經驗。使用客製化 SUS 或經驗不足的供應商會增加風險，但可以透過現場測試來緩解。這對 CDMO 的供應商管理策略有直接影響。
blocks.en: Another important point: building partnerships with major SUS suppliers can reduce risk, because they have extensive application experience. Using customized SUS or inexperienced suppliers increases risk, but this can be mitigated through on-site testing. This bears directly on a CDMO's supplier management strategy.

blocks.zh: 設備層級整合就像選購汽車引擎。你不能只看馬力（工作體積）這一個指標，還要考慮油耗（公用設施依賴）、排氣量（廢棄物產生）、散熱效率（加熱/冷卻需求）、耐用性（化學相容性）、安全氣囊（生物圍阻）、自動駕駛功能（控制系統）以及備用電池（UPS）。任何一個參數的疏忽都可能導致整台車無法正常運行。
blocks.en: Equipment-level integration is like choosing a car engine. You cannot look at horsepower (working volume) alone; you must also consider fuel consumption (utility dependence), exhaust output (waste generation), cooling efficiency (heating/cooling needs), durability (chemical compatibility), airbags (biocontainment), self-driving features (control system) and a backup battery (UPS). Neglecting any one parameter can keep the whole car from running properly.

blocks.zh: 在設備層級的 18 個驗證參數中，哪些參數對生物製劑的 SUS 特別關鍵？哪些對化學藥品的 SUS 更為重要？
blocks.en: Of the 18 validation parameters at equipment level, which are especially critical for SUS used with biologics, and which are more important for SUS used with chemical drugs?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 建議與「major SUS suppliers」建立夥伴關係，而非使用多家小型供應商？請從風險管理角度分析。
blocks.en: Why does TR66 recommend building partnerships with "major SUS suppliers" rather than using many small suppliers? Analyze this from a risk-management perspective.

blocks.zh: 7.4.8 Operational-Level Integration Plan 7.4.8 操作層次整合計畫
blocks.en: 7.4.8 Operational-Level Integration Plan

blocks.zh: Operational-Level Integration（營運層級整合）是 SUS 從「靜態設備」變成「可用系統」的關鍵轉換點。六個重點參數涵蓋了 SUS 從到貨到上線使用的完整流程：
blocks.en: Operational-Level Integration is the key transition at which the SUS changes from "static equipment" into a "usable system". Six key parameters cover the whole flow from delivery to use online:

blocks.zh: Preuse leak testing（使用前洩漏測試）— 確認 SUS 在運輸和儲存過程中未受損
blocks.en: Preuse leak testing - confirms that the SUS was not damaged during transport and storage

blocks.zh: Reuse policy（重複使用政策）— 原則上不建議重複使用，但在特定條件下（如未斷開連接的緩衝液容器）可接受
blocks.en: Reuse policy - reuse is not recommended in principle, but may be acceptable under specific conditions (such as a buffer container that has not been disconnected)

blocks.zh: Technical diligence（技術盡職調查）— 對 SUS 產品、供應商和製程相容性的深入了解
blocks.en: Technical diligence - an in-depth understanding of the SUS product, the supplier and process compatibility

blocks.zh: 營運層級最容易被忽略但影響最大的是人員訓練。袋體的塌陷可能導致應力裂紋，進而破壞結構和功能完整性 — 這是一個非常實際的操作風險。培訓主題應包括：
blocks.en: The aspect of operational-level integration that is most easily overlooked but has the greatest impact is personnel training. Collapse of a bag can cause stress cracks and in turn damage structural and functional integrity, which is a very real operational risk. Training topics should include:

blocks.zh: 不同類型的無菌連接和斷開裝置的使用
blocks.en: Use of the different types of aseptic connection and disconnection devices

blocks.zh: 部署過程中避免袋體褶皺或孔洞的技巧
blocks.en: Techniques for avoiding creases or holes in the bag during deployment

blocks.zh: 正確的搬運姿勢和方法
blocks.en: Correct handling posture and methods

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，操作人員的 SUS 專業訓練品質直接決定了產品品質和批次成功率。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, the quality of operators' SUS-specific training directly determines product quality and batch success rate.

blocks.zh: 營運層級整合就像飛行員的起飛前檢查清單。不管飛機設計得多好（設備層級）、機場跑道多完美（設施層級），如果起飛前的儀器檢查（洩漏測試）、機組人員訓練（Training）、油料有效期（Shelf life）沒有到位，飛行安全就無法保障。每一項看似瑣碎的檢查項目，都可能是決定任務成敗的關鍵。
blocks.en: Operational-level integration is like a pilot's pre-flight checklist. However well the aircraft is designed (equipment level) and however perfect the runway is (facility level), flight safety cannot be guaranteed if the pre-flight instrument check (leak testing), crew training (Training) and fuel expiry (Shelf life) are not in place. Every seemingly trivial check item can decide the success or failure of the mission.

blocks.zh: 在什麼情況下，SUS 的重複使用可能是可接受的？使用者需要進行哪些風險分析？
blocks.en: Under what circumstances might reuse of an SUS be acceptable? What risk analysis does the user need to perform?

blocks.zh: 為什麼同一款 off-the-shelf SUS 在不同應用中可能有不同的測試和放行標準？請舉例說明。
blocks.en: Why might the same off-the-shelf SUS have different testing and release criteria in different applications? Give an example.

blocks.zh: 7.4.9 Technological Survey 7.4.9 技術調查
blocks.en: 7.4.9 Technological Survey

blocks.zh: Technological Survey（技術調查）是對市場上可用的 SUS 技術解決方案進行系統性調研。其目的是確保選擇最佳可用技術 (Best Available Technology, BAT)。
blocks.en: The Technological Survey is a systematic investigation of the SUS technology solutions available on the market. Its purpose is to ensure that the Best Available Technology (BAT) is selected.

blocks.zh: SWOT Assessment（SWOT 分析）在此用於評估和比較不同的 SUS 解決方案：
blocks.en: SWOT Assessment is used here to evaluate and compare different SUS solutions:

blocks.zh: S (Strengths)：供應商的技術能力、產品成熟度
blocks.en: S (Strengths): the supplier's technical capability, product maturity

blocks.zh: W (Weaknesses)：產品限制、化學相容性問題
blocks.en: W (Weaknesses): product limitations, chemical compatibility issues

blocks.zh: O (Opportunities)：新技術、成本節省潛力
blocks.en: O (Opportunities): new technologies, cost-saving potential

blocks.zh: T (Threats)：供應鏈風險、專利限制
blocks.en: T (Threats): supply-chain risks, patent restrictions

blocks.zh: 技術調查可以在某些條件下省略 — 如果在 S1 階段已取得足夠的技術資訊。但如果實施路線圖的組織架構有所改變，必須確保實施流程不會失去結構性，所有必要元素的完整處理仍然到位。這個警告在 TR66 中多次出現，顯示實務中組織架構調整導致品質遺漏是常見問題。
blocks.en: The technological survey can be omitted under certain conditions, if sufficient technical information was already obtained in S1. However, if the organizational structure of the implementation roadmap changes, you must ensure that the implementation process does not lose its structure and that all necessary elements are still fully addressed. This warning appears several times in TR66, showing that quality omissions caused by organizational restructuring are a common problem in practice.

blocks.zh: 技術調查就像買房前的市場調研。你會查看不同建商的口碑（Suppliers）、問住過的朋友的經驗（In-house know-how）、參加房展會（Conferences）、閱讀建築雜誌（Journals）、加入購屋社群（Industry networks）。SWOT 分析則是你在幾個候選物件之間做比較時的決策工具。
blocks.en: A technological survey is like market research before buying a house. You look at the reputation of different developers (Suppliers), ask friends who have lived there about their experience (In-house know-how), attend property fairs (Conferences), read architecture magazines (Journals) and join home-buyer communities (Industry networks). A SWOT assessment is then the decision tool you use to compare several candidate properties.

blocks.zh: 7.4.10 Supplier Selection and Supply-Chain Review 7.4.10 供應商選擇與供應鏈審查
blocks.en: 7.4.10 Supplier Selection and Supply-Chain Review

blocks.zh: Technical Diligence（技術盡職調查）— 這是 TR66 中的核心概念之一。它不僅僅是供應商稽核，而是對 SUS 產品本身、供應商的技術能力以及 SUS 與使用者製程和設施的相容性進行全面深入的了解。基礎概念源自 APIC 盡職調查流程和 ASTM E2500-07。
blocks.en: Technical Diligence - one of the core concepts in TR66. It is more than a supplier audit: it is a comprehensive, in-depth understanding of the SUS product itself, the supplier's technical capability, and the compatibility of the SUS with the user's process and facility. The underlying concept derives from the APIC due diligence process and ASTM E2500-07.

blocks.zh: CDA/NDA（保密協議）— 為了實現供應商與使用者之間的資訊透明交流，可能需要簽署單向或雙向保密協議。這在早期專案階段特別重要，可以加速設計流程。
blocks.en: CDA/NDA (confidentiality agreement) - to allow transparent exchange of information between supplier and user, a unilateral or bilateral confidentiality agreement may need to be signed. This is especially important in the early project stages and can speed up the design process.

blocks.zh: Quality and Supply Agreement（品質與供應協議）— 用於常規 SUS 設備採購的正式合約，涵蓋品質標準、供應條款和變更通知等。臨時性採購可以用一般合約，但常規採購必須有品質供應協議。
blocks.en: Quality and Supply Agreement - the formal contract for routine purchase of SUS equipment, covering quality standards, supply terms, change notification and so on. A general contract may be used for ad hoc purchases, but routine purchases must have a quality and supply agreement.

blocks.zh: 供應商選擇的兩個核心風險：
blocks.en: Two core risks in supplier selection:

blocks.zh: Ad hoc selection（隨意選擇）— 設備和供應商的選擇不能是臨時起意的過程。這會導致不必要的重複採購和成本浪費，不論公司規模大小都可能發生。
blocks.en: Ad hoc selection - the selection of equipment and suppliers must not be an improvised process. It leads to unnecessary duplicate purchases and wasted cost, and can happen regardless of company size.

blocks.zh: Too many suppliers（過多供應商）— 與太多供應商合作會分散有限的資源。供應商管理本身就需要投入大量時間和人力，過多的供應商會壓縮用於 SUS 實施其他環節的資源。
blocks.en: Too many suppliers - working with too many suppliers spreads limited resources thin. Supplier management itself requires a great deal of time and manpower, and too many suppliers squeeze the resources available for other parts of SUS implementation.

blocks.zh: TR66 強調「起始物料（如樹脂和薄膜）應被視為關鍵原材料」— 這意味著它們需要與 API 起始物料同等級的管控和審查。
blocks.en: TR66 stresses that "starting materials (such as resins and films) should be considered critical raw materials", which means they need the same level of control and review as API starting materials.

blocks.zh: 供應商選擇與管理就像組建一支 F1 賽車團隊。你需要精心挑選引擎供應商（核心 SUS 供應商）、輪胎供應商（薄膜和配件供應商）和燃料供應商（樹脂等原材料）。與太多供應商合作就像賽車有太多不同品牌的零件 — 整合成本暴增、故障排除困難。而 Technical Diligence 就是你在簽約前對每個供應商進行的徹底試車和技術評估。CDA 則是賽車隊之間保護技術機密的協議。
blocks.en: Supplier selection and management is like putting together an F1 racing team. You need to choose carefully an engine supplier (core SUS supplier), a tire supplier (film and accessory suppliers) and a fuel supplier (raw materials such as resins). Working with too many suppliers is like a race car with parts from too many different brands: integration cost soars and troubleshooting becomes difficult. Technical Diligence is the thorough test drive and technical evaluation you carry out on each supplier before signing. The CDA is the agreement that protects technical secrets between racing teams.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 將 SUS 的樹脂和薄膜歸類為「critical raw materials」？這對供應商管理策略有什麼影響？
blocks.en: Why does TR66 classify SUS resins and films as "critical raw materials"? What does this mean for supplier management strategy?

blocks.zh: 臨時性 SUS 採購和常規 SUS 採購在合約要求上有什麼不同？為什麼常規採購必須有 Quality and Supply Agreement？
blocks.en: How do contract requirements differ between ad hoc SUS purchases and routine SUS purchases? Why must routine purchases have a Quality and Supply Agreement?

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，如何平衡「減少供應商數量」與「維持供應鏈韌性」之間的矛盾？
blocks.en: In a CDMO environment, how can the tension between "reducing the number of suppliers" and "maintaining supply-chain resilience" be balanced?

blocks.zh: 7.4.11 Extractables and Leachables Database 7.4.11 可萃取物與溶出物資料庫
blocks.en: 7.4.11 Extractables and Leachables Database

blocks.zh: E&L Database（萃取物與溶出物資料庫）— E&L 是 SUS 實施中最重要的安全性考量之一：
blocks.en: E&L Database - E&L is one of the most important safety considerations in SUS implementation:

blocks.zh: Extractables（萃取物）— 在加嚴條件下從 SUS 材料中萃取出的化合物
blocks.en: Extractables - compounds extracted from SUS materials under exaggerated (aggressive) conditions

blocks.zh: Leachables（溶出物）— 在正常製程條件下從 SUS 材料遷移到產品中的化合物
blocks.en: Leachables - compounds that migrate from SUS materials into the product under normal process conditions

blocks.zh: TR66 建議最遲在 S4 階段開始收集 Extractables 資料，Leachables 資料可以延後到 S5 階段收集。
blocks.en: TR66 recommends that extractables data collection begin no later than the S4 stage, while leachables data can be collected later, in the S5 stage.

blocks.zh: 雖然這一小節篇幅簡短，但 E&L 的重要性不容小覷。及早建立 E&L 資料庫有以下好處：(1) 在供應商選擇階段就能排除不適合的材料；(2) 為後續的規格制定和確效提供基礎數據；(3) 法規申報時需要完整的 E&L 數據。對 CDMO 而言，系統化的 E&L 資料庫是跨客戶專案的重要資產。
blocks.en: Although this subsection is short, the importance of E&L should not be underestimated. Building an E&L database early has the following benefits: (1) unsuitable materials can be excluded already at the supplier selection stage; (2) it provides baseline data for later specification setting and validation; (3) complete E&L data are needed for regulatory submissions. For a CDMO, a systematic E&L database is an important asset across client projects.

blocks.zh: 7.5 Implementation S5: Development 7.5 實施階段 S5：開發
blocks.en: 7.5 Implementation S5: Development

blocks.zh: Implementation S5: Development（開發階段）— 在 S4 的商業案例建立之後，S5 聚焦於將策略轉化為具體的使用者需求文件。此階段的關鍵輸出包括：使用者需求 (User Requirements)、佈局與設計、規格書 (Specifications) 和標準化政策。重要的是，完整的使用者需求必須在採購流程之前完成。
blocks.en: Implementation S5: Development - After the business case has been established in S4, S5 focuses on turning the strategy into concrete user requirements documents. The key outputs of this stage include user requirements, layout and design, specifications and the standardization policy. Importantly, complete user requirements must be finished before the procurement process.

blocks.zh: S5 的核心原則：先定義需求，再開始採購。在實務中，很多組織因為時程壓力而跳過完整的需求定義直接進入採購，結果往往導致規格不匹配、變更訂單增加和專案延誤。這個順序不可顛倒。
blocks.en: The core principle of S5 is define requirements first, then start procurement. In practice, many organizations skip complete requirements definition under schedule pressure and go straight to procurement, which often results in mismatched specifications, more change orders and project delays. This order must not be reversed.

blocks.zh: 7.5.1 User Requirements for Implementation 7.5.1 實施之使用者需求
blocks.en: 7.5.1 User Requirements for Implementation

blocks.zh: User Requirements（使用者需求）— SUS 實施的基礎文件，基於三大支柱：
blocks.en: User Requirements - the foundation document of SUS implementation, based on three pillars:

blocks.zh: 產品與製程知識— 了解產品特性和製程參數
blocks.en: Product and process knowledge - understanding of product characteristics and process parameters

blocks.zh: CQA（關鍵品質屬性）— 影響產品安全性和有效性的品質特性
blocks.en: CQA (critical quality attributes) - quality characteristics that affect product safety and efficacy

blocks.zh: 法規要求— 適用的 GMP 和法規規範
blocks.en: Regulatory requirements - applicable GMP and regulatory standards

blocks.zh: 使用者需求可以採用 QbD（品質源於設計）方法，將產品和製程控制策略作為定義 SUS 需求的前提條件。
blocks.en: User requirements can follow a QbD (quality by design) approach, using the product and process control strategy as the premise for defining SUS requirements.

blocks.zh: 使用者需求文件的管理有幾個重要原則：
blocks.en: Several important principles apply to managing user requirements documents:

blocks.zh: 文件複雜度應匹配風險等級：低風險小規模 SUS 可以將需求和功能規格合併在一份文件中；複雜系統則需要多份文件，但必須避免文件之間的衝突
blocks.en: Document complexity should match the risk level: a low-risk, small-scale SUS can combine requirements and functional specifications in a single document; complex systems need multiple documents, but conflicts between documents must be avoided

blocks.zh: 供應商文件可以補充甚至替代公司文件：前提是供應商遵循 GEP、有適當的品質系統、並符合 ASTM E2500-07 的技術能力要求
blocks.en: Supplier documents can supplement or even replace company documents: provided the supplier follows GEP, has an appropriate quality system and meets the technical capability requirements of ASTM E2500-07

blocks.zh: 使用者需求是活文件：必須在系統生命週期中保持更新，任何用途變更、使用者需求變更或材料規格變更都需要重新評估
blocks.en: User requirements are a living document: they must be kept up to date throughout the system life cycle, and any change of use, change in user requirements or change in material specification requires reassessment

blocks.zh: 使用者需求文件就像訂製西裝前的量身記錄。你必須先測量身材數據（產品和製程知識）、了解穿著場合（CQA）、確認禮儀規範（法規要求），然後才能讓裁縫（供應商）開始製作。如果你讓三個裁縫分別做上衣、褲子和背心，必須確保尺寸規格不會互相矛盾（避免多文件衝突）。而且，如果你增重或減重了（製程變更），量身數據就需要更新。
blocks.en: A user requirements document is like the measurements taken before a bespoke suit is made. You must first take the body measurements (product and process knowledge), understand the occasion of wear (CQA) and confirm the dress code (regulatory requirements), and only then let the tailor (supplier) start making it. If you have three tailors make the jacket, trousers and waistcoat separately, you must make sure the measurements do not contradict one another (avoiding conflicts between documents). And if you gain or lose weight (process change), the measurements need to be updated.

blocks.zh: 在什麼條件下，供應商的文件可以替代終端使用者自己編寫的使用者需求文件？
blocks.en: Under what conditions can supplier documents replace user requirements documents written by the end user?

blocks.zh: 如果 CDMO 的客戶變更了產品配方（例如更換緩衝液組成），使用者需求文件中哪些部分需要重新評估？
blocks.en: If a CDMO's client changes the product formulation (for example, changes the buffer composition), which parts of the user requirements document need to be reassessed?

blocks.zh: 7.5.2 Preparing User Requirements 7.5.2 準備使用者需求
blocks.en: 7.5.2 Preparing User Requirements

blocks.zh: 使用者需求的撰寫是一門平衡的藝術，需要在兩個極端之間取得平衡：
blocks.en: Writing user requirements is an art of balance between two extremes:

blocks.zh: 足夠具體：能描述 SUS 功能、可驗證是否滿足需求、涵蓋製程與材料相容性
blocks.en: Specific enough: to describe SUS functions, to allow verification that the requirement is met, and to cover process and material compatibility

blocks.zh: 足夠概括：不會限制系統設計的彈性空間
blocks.en: General enough: so as not to restrict flexibility in system design

blocks.zh: Functional Risk Assessment（功能性風險評估）可用於進一步評估關鍵需求。例如，一個整合型 SUS 由多個來源的組件組成時（如生物反應器硬體和 SUS 袋來自不同供應商），需要識別每個組件的 CQA。
blocks.en: Functional Risk Assessment can be used to evaluate critical requirements further. For example, when an integrated SUS consists of components from multiple sources (such as bioreactor hardware and SUS bags from different suppliers), the CQAs of each component need to be identified.

blocks.zh: 需求收集的方法多元：腦力激盪、工作坊、訪談、評估和非正式討論。TR66 特別指出需求可能「最初並非完全定義」而在後續階段進一步開發 — 這反映了 SUS 實施的迭代本質。
blocks.en: There are many methods for gathering requirements: brainstorming, workshops, interviews, assessments and informal discussions. TR66 specifically notes that requirements may be "not fully defined initially" and developed further in later stages, which reflects the iterative nature of SUS implementation.

blocks.zh: 同時注意兩個關鍵提醒：
blocks.en: Two further key reminders:

blocks.zh: 必須有變更管控流程來管理使用者需求的變更
blocks.en: A change control process must be in place to manage changes to user requirements

blocks.zh: 必須確保利害關係人在整個 SUS 生命週期中獲得充分且定期的溝通
blocks.en: It must be ensured that stakeholders receive adequate and regular communication throughout the SUS life cycle

blocks.zh: 撰寫使用者需求就像訂披薩：你需要說「我要一個 12 吋的瑪格麗特披薩，不要洋蔥」（具體到可以驗證），但不需要說「麵團必須用 00 號義大利麵粉，水溫 38 度，發酵時間 24 小時」（太具體會限制廚師的專業發揮）。如果你對特定供應商有特殊的功能需求（例如無麩質），那就必須明確寫出來。
blocks.en: Writing user requirements is like ordering a pizza: you need to say "I want a 12-inch Margherita, no onions" (specific enough to verify), but you do not need to say "the dough must use 00 Italian flour, water at 38 degrees, fermented for 24 hours" (too specific restricts the chef's professional judgment). If you have a special functional need that depends on a particular supplier (such as gluten-free), you must state it explicitly.

blocks.zh: 使用者需求如何在「足夠具體」和「足夠概括」之間取得平衡？請以 SUS 混合袋為例說明。
blocks.en: How can user requirements balance being "specific enough" and "general enough"? Use an SUS mixing bag as an example.

blocks.zh: 當一個整合型 SUS 由多個供應商提供組件時，功能性風險評估應如何進行？
blocks.en: When an integrated SUS has components supplied by multiple suppliers, how should the functional risk assessment be carried out?

blocks.zh: 7.5.3 Layout and Design 7.5.3 佈局與設計
blocks.en: 7.5.3 Layout and Design

blocks.zh: S88 Batch-Automation Standard（S88 批次自動化標準）— 這是 ISA（國際自動化學會）的標準，提供了一個結構化的方法來設計和控制批次製造流程。TR66 借用這個標準的框架來確保 SUS 設計的完整性，將設計拆分為三個關鍵元素：
blocks.en: S88 Batch-Automation Standard - an ISA (International Society of Automation) standard that provides a structured approach to designing and controlling batch manufacturing processes. TR66 borrows the framework of this standard to ensure the completeness of SUS design, splitting the design into three key elements:

blocks.zh: Operations（操作）— 從運輸安裝到製造操作的完整流程
blocks.en: Operations - the complete flow from transport and installation to manufacturing operations

blocks.zh: Equipment（設備 - 可重複使用部件）— 袋體支架、控制系統、泵浦等
blocks.en: Equipment (reusable parts) - bag supports, control systems, pumps and so on

blocks.zh: Materials（材料 - 一次性部件）— 袋體、管路、連接器等
blocks.en: Materials (single-use parts) - bags, tubing, connectors and so on

blocks.zh: Layout and Design 的「Typical Considerations」清單是 SUS 設計的實用檢查表。特別注意：
blocks.en: The "Typical Considerations" list in Layout and Design is a practical checklist for SUS design. Pay particular attention to:

blocks.zh: Ergonomics（人因工程）— SUS 操作通常比 MUS 需要更多的手動操作（如袋體安裝、管路連接），人因工程設計直接影響操作效率和錯誤率
blocks.en: Ergonomics - SUS operation usually requires more manual handling than MUS (such as bag installation and tubing connections), so ergonomic design directly affects operating efficiency and error rate

blocks.zh: Staging processes（分階段流程）— 從 Setting up 到 Dismantling 的七個步驟定義了 SUS 的完整使用週期
blocks.en: Staging processes - the seven steps from Setting up to Dismantling define the complete usage cycle of an SUS

blocks.zh: SU parts 中的 Sensors（感測器）— 一次性感測器（如 pH、DO 探頭）是 SUS 中技術挑戰較大的部分
blocks.en: Sensors in SU parts - single-use sensors (such as pH and DO probes) are the technically more challenging part of an SUS

blocks.zh: SUS 的佈局設計就像設計一個組合式行動廚房（用於大型戶外宴會）。Operations 是整個烹飪流程（從食材搬運到上菜撤盤）；Equipment 是可以反覆使用的設備（瓦斯爐、工作台、冰箱）；Materials 是每次使用後丟棄的物品（鋁箔紙、保鮮膜、烘焙紙）。S88 標準的方法論確保你不會只設計了廚房但忘了規劃從停車場到廚房的搬運動線。
blocks.en: SUS layout design is like designing a modular mobile kitchen (for a large outdoor banquet). Operations is the whole cooking process (from moving ingredients to serving and clearing dishes); Equipment is the equipment that can be used repeatedly (gas stove, work table, refrigerator); Materials is what is discarded after each use (aluminum foil, plastic wrap, baking paper). The S88 methodology ensures that you do not design only the kitchen and forget to plan the material flow from the parking lot to the kitchen.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 建議使用 S88 批次自動化標準的框架來進行 SUS 設計？這個標準如何確保「設計完整性」？
blocks.en: Why does TR66 recommend using the framework of the S88 batch-automation standard for SUS design? How does this standard ensure "design completeness"?

blocks.zh: 在 SUS 的 Layout and Design 中，人因工程 (Ergonomics) 為什麼特別重要？請舉一個因為人因設計不佳導致操作失敗的潛在情境。
blocks.en: Why is ergonomics especially important in SUS Layout and Design? Give an example of a potential scenario in which poor ergonomic design leads to an operational failure.

blocks.zh: 7.5.4 Specification 7.5.4 規格
blocks.en: 7.5.4 Specification

blocks.zh: Specifications（規格書）是設計流程的具體產出，將使用者需求轉化為可測量、可驗證的技術要求。規格的表達方式包括：描述性文字、計算結果、圖表和流程圖、以及與現有設備的參照比較。
blocks.en: Specifications are the concrete output of the design process, translating user requirements into measurable, verifiable technical requirements. Specifications can be expressed through descriptive text, calculation results, diagrams and flowcharts, and reference comparisons with existing equipment.

blocks.zh: Periodic Design Review（定期設計審查）是確保設計持續符合需求的關鍵機制。特別要注意 SUS 的交付和安裝過程 — 必須確保 SUS 以能整合進設施的形式交付。
blocks.en: Periodic Design Review is the key mechanism for ensuring that the design continues to meet requirements. Pay special attention to the delivery and installation of the SUS: it must be ensured that the SUS is delivered in a form that can be integrated into the facility.

blocks.zh: 規格書涵蓋 MU 和 SU 兩個部分 — 這很重要，因為 SUS 系統通常是混合系統（MU 硬體 + SU 組件），規格必須同時考慮兩者。定期設計審查的目的是在發現問題時能及早糾正，避免在製造完成後才發現設計不符合需求，導致昂貴的返工。
blocks.en: Specifications cover both the MU and SU parts. This matters because an SUS is usually a hybrid system (MU hardware + SU components), and the specification must consider both. The purpose of periodic design review is to correct problems early when they are found, avoiding the discovery after manufacture that the design does not meet requirements, which leads to expensive rework.

blocks.zh: 7.5.5 Standardization Policy 7.5.5 標準化政策
blocks.en: 7.5.5 Standardization Policy

blocks.zh: Standardization Policy（標準化政策）是控制 SUS 設計彈性所帶來的供應鏈變異的關鍵策略。TR66 提出三種實用的標準化方法：
blocks.en: The Standardization Policy is the key strategy for controlling the supply-chain variability that comes with SUS design flexibility. TR66 proposes three practical standardization approaches:

blocks.zh: Bag ranges（袋體範圍系列化）— 選擇標準化的工作體積，讓一系列的袋體規格能涵蓋多種應用需求
blocks.en: Bag ranges - select standardized working volumes so that a series of bag sizes can cover a variety of application needs

blocks.zh: Connection standardization（連接標準化）— 統一袋體和管路的連接方式，同時保留多種連接可能性
blocks.en: Connection standardization - unify the way bags and tubing are connected while still retaining multiple connection possibilities

blocks.zh: SU Toolbox（一次性工具箱）— 建立標準化的附件庫（Y 型接頭、取樣歧管、管路段），讓特殊需求可以透過附件附加到標準化袋體設計上
blocks.en: SU Toolbox - build a standardized library of accessories (Y-connectors, sampling manifolds, tubing sections) so that special needs can be met by attaching accessories to standardized bag designs

blocks.zh: 標準化政策就像 LEGO 積木的設計理念。LEGO 的偉大之處在於用有限數量的標準化零件（標準的凸點間距和尺寸）來實現無限的組合可能。SU Toolbox 就是你的「特殊零件盒」— 當標準零件無法滿足需求時，你可以從中取出 Y 型接頭或取樣歧管來擴展功能。這比為每個應用訂製全新的設計要高效得多。
blocks.en: A standardization policy is like the design philosophy behind LEGO bricks. The brilliance of LEGO lies in achieving unlimited combinations from a limited number of standardized parts (standard stud spacing and dimensions). The SU Toolbox is your "special parts box": when standard parts cannot meet the need, you can take out a Y-connector or sampling manifold to extend functionality. This is far more efficient than ordering a completely new design for every application.

blocks.zh: SUS 的靈活性是雙面刃：優點是可以快速客製化，缺點是如果不加控制，每個操作者或每個專案都可能創建不同的設計，導致供應鏈變異激增、庫存管理困難、人員訓練成本上升。標準化政策的核心目標是「在保持必要彈性的同時，最大化可重複性和可預測性」。
blocks.en: The flexibility of SUS is a double-edged sword: the advantage is rapid customization; the disadvantage is that, without control, each operator or each project may create a different design, causing supply-chain variability to surge, inventory management to become difficult and training costs to rise. The core objective of a standardization policy is "to maximize repeatability and predictability while retaining the necessary flexibility".

blocks.zh: 如果一家 CDMO 在不同客戶專案中使用了 15 種不同的 SUS 袋體設計，這會帶來哪些管理挑戰？標準化政策如何幫助解決？
blocks.en: If a CDMO uses 15 different SUS bag designs across different client projects, what management challenges would this create? How can a standardization policy help solve them?

blocks.zh: 「SU Toolbox」的概念如何在保持標準化的同時滿足特殊應用需求？
blocks.en: How does the "SU Toolbox" concept meet special application needs while maintaining standardization?

blocks.zh: 7.5.6 Extractables and Leachables 7.5.6 可萃取物與溶出物
blocks.en: 7.5.6 Extractables and Leachables

blocks.zh: E&L 的法規環境在 2014 年（TR66 出版時）尚無 SUS 專屬的法規指引文件，但 USP、FDA 和 EMA 有針對一次性技術的廣泛 E&L 指引。業界也有多項跨產業標準化倡議，致力於：
blocks.en: As of 2014 (when TR66 was published), there was no SUS-specific regulatory guidance document on the E&L regulatory environment, but USP, FDA and EMA had extensive E&L guidance relevant to single-use technologies. The industry also had several cross-industry standardization initiatives working to:

blocks.zh: 統一 SUS 的 E&L 評估方法
blocks.en: Harmonize the E&L assessment methods for SUS

blocks.zh: 達成產業和法規共識
blocks.en: Reach industry and regulatory consensus

blocks.zh: 建立跨產業的知識資料庫
blocks.en: Build a cross-industry knowledge database

blocks.zh: 如果 E&L 資料庫在 S4 尚未開始建立，S5 是最後的建立時機。E&L 數據的收集需要時間，且可能影響材料選擇和設計決策。越早開始收集，越能減少後期發現材料不適用而需要重新設計的風險。
blocks.en: If the E&L database has not been started in S4, S5 is the last opportunity to build it. Collecting E&L data takes time and may affect material selection and design decisions. The earlier collection starts, the lower the risk of discovering late that a material is unsuitable and the design must be redone.

blocks.zh: 7.5.7 Procurement 7.5.7 採購
blocks.en: 7.5.7 Procurement

blocks.zh: Procurement（採購）是將使用者需求和規格書轉化為實際訂單的關鍵步驟。TR66 列出六個關鍵考量：
blocks.en: Procurement is the key step that turns the user requirements and specifications into actual orders. TR66 lists six key considerations:

blocks.zh: PEP 中的採購規劃— 採購流程應在 PEP 中預先規劃
blocks.en: Procurement planning in the PEP - the procurement process should be planned in advance in the PEP

blocks.zh: 利害關係人的角色與責任— 特別是在品質供應協議尚未建立時
blocks.en: Roles and responsibilities of stakeholders - especially when a quality and supply agreement has not yet been established

blocks.zh: 合約條款— 包括 Incoterms（國際貿易條件）的遵守
blocks.en: Contract terms - including compliance with Incoterms (international commercial terms)

blocks.zh: 專案管理— 確保專案時程不脫軌
blocks.en: Project management - ensuring the project schedule does not slip

blocks.zh: Change-Notification Process（變更通知流程）— 監控供應商端的設計變更
blocks.en: Change-Notification Process - monitoring design changes on the supplier side

blocks.zh: 驗收標準的及時驗證— 避免不必要的延誤
blocks.en: Timely verification of acceptance criteria - avoiding unnecessary delays

blocks.zh: 採購流程中最關鍵的風險控制點是變更通知流程。SUS 供應商可能在採購期間變更材料、設計或製程，如果沒有正式的變更通知機制，終端使用者可能在不知情的情況下收到與原始規格不同的產品。這對產品品質和法規合規性有重大影響。
blocks.en: The most critical risk-control point in the procurement process is the change-notification process. An SUS supplier may change materials, design or process during the procurement period; without a formal change-notification mechanism, the end user may receive a product that differs from the original specification without knowing it. This has a major impact on product quality and regulatory compliance.

blocks.zh: 另一個容易被忽視的重點：合約條款中的 Incoterms（國際貿易條件）定義了運輸過程中風險和費用的分擔方式。SUS 在運輸過程中特別脆弱（薄膜材料容易受損），選擇正確的 Incoterms 條款可以明確責任歸屬。
blocks.en: Another easily overlooked point: the Incoterms (international commercial terms) in the contract terms define how risk and cost are shared during transport. SUS are especially vulnerable in transit (film materials are easily damaged), and choosing the right Incoterms clause can make clear where responsibility lies.

blocks.zh: SUS 採購就像訂製精密的醫療器材。你不能只簽一張訂單然後等貨到 — 你需要持續監控製造商是否按照你的規格生產（驗收驗證）、是否偷偷換了原材料（變更通知流程）、運輸過程中是否妥善保護（Incoterms）、以及如果有爭議該怎麼處理（合約條款）。
blocks.en: SUS procurement is like ordering precision medical devices. You cannot simply sign an order and wait for delivery; you need to keep monitoring whether the manufacturer is producing to your specification (acceptance verification), whether raw materials have been quietly swapped (change-notification process), whether the goods are properly protected in transit (Incoterms), and how disputes will be handled (contract terms).

blocks.zh: CDMO 的採購部門應建立 SUS 專屬的採購 SOP，涵蓋：
blocks.en: A CDMO's procurement department should establish an SUS-specific procurement SOP covering:

blocks.zh: 採購前的需求確認和規格審查流程
blocks.en: Requirements confirmation and specification review process before purchase

blocks.zh: 與供應商的變更通知協議模板
blocks.en: A template change-notification agreement with suppliers

blocks.zh: 到貨驗收的標準檢查清單
blocks.en: A standard checklist for incoming-goods acceptance

blocks.zh: 不符合規格時的處理程序（退貨、讓步接受等）
blocks.en: Procedures for handling nonconformance with specifications (return, acceptance by concession, etc.)

blocks.zh: 緊急採購的授權和簡化流程
blocks.en: Authorization and a simplified process for urgent purchases

blocks.zh: 如果 SUS 供應商在製造過程中變更了薄膜材料但未通知終端使用者，可能造成哪些後果？
blocks.en: What consequences could result if an SUS supplier changes the film material during manufacture without notifying the end user?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR66 強調在品質供應協議建立之前，利害關係人的角色與責任定義「extremely important」？
blocks.en: Why does TR66 stress that defining the roles and responsibilities of stakeholders before a quality and supply agreement is established is "extremely important"?
